providers.dataset: GSI Bhusanket (NLSM 1:50k/1:10k, Statewise Reports) & Bhukosh Landslide Inventory
resolution_steps: Public Bhusanket portal (https://bhusanket.gsi.gov.in/) provides 1,044 statewise PDF reports and NLSM 1:10k map viewer, not bulk GeoJSON/Shapefile downloads.

For GIS point/polygon landslide inventories and 1:50,000 lithology/fault layers, register a free user account on GSI Bhukosh (https://bhukosh.gsi.gov.in/Bhukosh/Public) or submit a formal data request via https://www.gsi.gov.in/.
Export Assam / Dima Hasao Landslide Inventory Shapefile (.zip) and place into backend/data/raw/gsi_landslides/.
providers.blocker_note: Public portal reachable, but machine-readable GIS inventory requires account registration or formal institutional data request.

providers.dataset: Landslide Atlas of India (1998–2022) & Bhuvan Disaster Services
resolution_steps: The public ISRO Landslide Atlas page distributes a summary PDF (/media_isro/pdf/LandslideAtlas_new_2023.pdf) containing district rankings and aggregate statistics, NOT machine-readable event coordinates.
For georeferenced point/polygon inventories in Dima Hasao, register on ISRO Bhuvan or submit an institutional research request to NRSC Hyderabad / NESAC Shillong.
Do NOT transcribe aggregate PDF charts into synthetic point coordinates.
providers.blocker_note: Public portal reachable, but machine-readable GIS inventory requires account registration or formal institutional data request.

providers.dataset: NASA Cooperative Open Online Landslide Repository (COOLR — Reports & Events FeatureServers)
resolution_steps: Retrieved automatically via backend/ingestion/fetch_coolr_landslides.py (104 verified records in 50 km buffer; 19 inside Dima Hasao polygon; 0 in COOLR_Events_Points).
All 19 Dima Hasao COOLR records have 1 km–50 km or 'unknown' location_accuracy (0 exact <= 100 m), so they are suitable ONLY for contextual visualization, NOT 30 m/90 m slope-scale ML training.
providers.blocker_note: Public ArcGIS FeatureServer reachable; retrieved records are coarse (1 km–50 km) media reports unsuitable for 30 m ML training.

scientific_note: NASA COOLR returned 104 verified records in the 50 km buffer (19 inside Dima Hasao polygon), of which 0 meet <= 100 m positional accuracy required for 30 m/90 m slope-scale ML training. No synthetic or hardcoded landslide labels are generated. Field-validated GSI Bhukosh / ISRO NRSC polygons remain required.
